info.title: SunCharts EHR Clinical API
info.description: API specification Apache-2.0; implementation AGPL-3.0-only. Synthetic development preview. OAuth2 authorization code with S256 PKCE, scoped opaque tokens and explicit local consent connects independent installations to SunCharts. Tenant/user identity is derived from authenticated credentials. Legacy HS256 assertions require ENGINE_ALLOW_LEGACY_GATEWAY=true. FHIR R4 native projections and bounded Patient, clinical-list and local draft-order writes form an initial boundary; no US Core, SMART or ONC claim. Imports preserve source history and never authorize cutover. No automatic mutation retries.

oauth2.description: Pre-register confidential clients locally. Exact callback, state, issuer response validation and S256 PKCE required. Access tokens last 300 seconds; refresh tokens rotate and replay revokes the grant. Not SMART or OIDC.

clientBasic.description: Registered client ID and secret; token and revocation endpoints only.

patientPortalSession.name: sce_portal
patientPortalSession.description: Separate patient portal session; HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure over HTTPS; Path=/api/v1/patient-portal. Not a staff browser session or OAuth credential. All mutations require configured Origin. 20-minute inactivity timeout and bounded absolute expiry; account/version revocation enforced.

LabObservation.description: Exactly one typed value: finite number plus nonempty units for numeric; nonempty text; Coding for coded; or nonempty absent_reason. Other typed value fields must be empty/null. Absent observations require unknown flag. Units/codes are recorded as supplied, not terminology-validated. Flags are not calculated from numeric ranges.

source.description: Immutable history ID, source identifiers, original source_data and normalized data; no inferred timezone/status/provider

amount_cents.description: Complete USD line total for the stated units; never multiplied by units again

coverage_snapshot.description: Frozen payer and policy versions captured at local posting; no eligibility assertion

status.description: Supported ordinary statuses 1,2,3,4,19,20,21; 22 is an exact-original signed reversal requiring a reviewed source posting.

EraDocument.description: At least one claim or provider adjustment. USD BPR equals summed CLP paid cents minus signed PLB cents. Provider-only settlements and exact-original negative CLP22 supported; unsupported profiles remain held.

reverses_remittance_id.description: Required for CLP22; exact posted original remittance

reverses_row_index.description: Zero-based original posted claim row required for CLP22

correction_of_remittance_id.description: Explicit positive-correction source: the active exact reversal remittance, including an earlier transaction in the same batch.

correction_of_row_index.description: Zero-based reversal row; pair with correction_of_remittance_id.

automation.description: Provider staging provenance and immutable findings; suggested matches still require staff review

ClaimPacket.description: SunCharts JSON packet with frozen patient, payer, account and reviewed provider/diagnosis content. not_x12_837=true. No transmission or automatic claim state change.

ClaimWorklist.description: Tenant-scoped claim summary page with patient_name, payer_name, total_cents and lifecycle; at most 100 items

RemittanceWorklist.description: Tenant-scoped remittance summary page; at most 100 items

items.description: Immutable original text/hash, parsed results, source link and attributed reason
Patient/claim/partner, frozen usage, control identifiers and independent delivery/technical/payer states
Tenant scoped x12_partner/edi_acknowledgment source evidence and native reconciliation ID

ProviderConnection.description: Safe tenant-scoped durable state; endpoints, secrets, binding hash and opaque page token are excluded.

RetrievedReport.description: Original text and metadata appear in detail only. Immutable provider/account/report identity, content/hash and native links; bounded append-only events.

issues.description: Immutable findings at staging, not a current posting authorization

amount_cents.description: Signed PLB source amount. Positive decreases provider settlement cash; negative increases it.

original_text.description: Exact original ASCII 835 file, up to 20 transaction sets; multiple groups/interchanges or unwrapped transactions.

payer_ids.description: Native payer IDs in source transaction order; exact payer-code match required.

versions.description: Exact ordered child versions from batch detail. Posting also requires the previously reconciled vector.

ProviderSetting.description: Owner-only redacted Claim.MD configuration. Credentials, ciphertext, fingerprints and private key paths are never returned.

account_key.description: Required on creation; omit on update to keep saved key. No whitespace. A replacement key invalidates verification and creates a fresh route revision.

AvsSnapshot.description: Server-selected native clinical summary. No SOAP or private medication/order notes are copied. Optional allergy/problem/review/vitals fields may be absent in earlier releases; unknown and no-known remain distinct. Draft/cancelled order status is retained.

snapshot.description: Immutable task snapshot including identity, assignee, due date and lifecycle state; excludes tenant, creation hash and request UUID.

preview_digest.description: Digest returned by checkout GET; recomputed under clinical-list/order serialization before release. No release timestamp participates.

reviewed_snapshot_digest.description: Digest returned by checkout GET; recomputed under clinical-list/order serialization before release. No release timestamp participates.

due_date.description: Date-only value from 2000-01-01 through 2100-12-31; no UTC conversion.

api_key.description: Own account test-only sk_test_ or rk_test_ credential; blank preserves saved same-mode credential.

onboarding_url.description: Only verified broker origin + actual owner setup path. Does not grant anonymous financial onboarding.

utc_offset_minutes.description: UTC offset at start; validated using named timezone.

RecurringAppointmentPlan.description: Explicit finite plan. Same local start time and elapsed UTC duration. Daily/weekly/monthly cadence anchored to first date; monthly clamps original day to month end. Last local start within 12 calendar months. Canonical request digest provides exact UUID retry idempotence; changed content with same UUID conflicts.

utc_offset_minutes.description: UTC offset at start; validated using named timezone.

RecurringAppointmentPreview.description: Preview reserves no slots. An exact already-created request returns existing_series_id and no rows.

occurrence_versions.description: All members in position order, including members that will be preserved. Any stale member conflicts.

api_key.description: Resend key; omit/blank retains the current key. Never returned.

delivery_mode.description: Managed SunCharts email or own Resend account. Omission preserves existing own-account API compatibility.

ReminderSenderSave.description: Own Resend requires from_email and a key on first save. Managed mode requires verified, enabled Connect services. Saving always disables sending.

installation_token.description: One-time service installation token. Omit only to retain a saved token for the same installation.

code.description: Trimmed and uppercased before syntax checking. Canonical syntax: uppercase letter, digit, alphanumeric, optional decimal then1–4 alphanumerics. No terminology edition validation.

diagnoses.description: Ordered unique canonical codes. First entry is primary; empty array explicitly clears.

reason.description: Nonblank attributed reason for this revision.

id.description: Retained while the canonical code remains in the list.

actor_label.description: Current staff display name or email when available; actor_id retains stable attribution.

uploader_label.description: Current display name/email when available; uploaded_by preserves stable attribution.

WritableFhirCondition.description: Strict supported subset; dates have full YYYY-MM-DD precision only. clinicalStatus required except entered-in-error, which omits it. POST forbids id/meta, PUT requires id. No unsupported fields are discarded.

WritableFhirAllergyIntolerance.description: Strict supported subset; dates have full YYYY-MM-DD precision only. clinicalStatus required except entered-in-error, which omits it. POST forbids id/meta, PUT requires id. No unsupported fields are discarded.

WritableFhirMedicationStatement.description: Strict supported subset; dates have full YYYY-MM-DD precision only. clinicalStatus required except entered-in-error, which omits it. POST forbids id/meta, PUT requires id. No unsupported fields are discarded.

WritableFhirServiceRequest.description: Single-test local draft only. category.text is laboratory, imaging or procedure; reasonCode.text is the clinical reason; performer.display is the recorded destination. No placement or network execution.

PrescriptionContent.description: Positive decimal quantity as a string, numeric RxNorm code when supplied. Local authorization blocks all controlled substances. Optional dates must be ordered.

PortalNewThread.description: appointment_change requires appointment_id belonging to the logged-in patient. message requires no appointment_id. Conversation does not modify a booking.

signed_snapshot.description: Immutable local authorization snapshot; does not establish transmission or dispensing.

invitation_url.description: One-time activation credential; securely hand off without logging.

ErxCredentialsInput.description: Write only. The entire credential block is replaced when supplied; null retains it unless clear_credentials is true. Never provide EPCS authenticator codes or patient data.

ImmunizationContent.description: Exactly one occurrence timestamp/date/nonempty historical description. Administered requires timestamp, active authorized local performer, dose, route and site. Not-given requires reason and excludes dose/lot/performer. Secondary reports require report_origin; primary reports omit it. No future occurrence or occurrence before patient birth. Record type cannot change; status changes only through native entered-in-error action.

value.description: Positive decimal; zero rejected; up to three decimal places. Units are recorded text, not validated UCUM.

occurrenceDateTime.description: Exact YYYY-MM-DD date or full RFC3339 timestamp with offset. Administered requires full timestamp.

occurrenceString.description: Historical only; no date is inferred from this text.

WritableFhirImmunization.description: Bounded native vaccine-event subset. Exactly one occurrenceDateTime/occurrenceString. Explicit native record-type extension is required and distinct from primarySource. Performer is a local staff identifier, not an invented Practitioner resource. New entered-in-error records, unsupported fields, recorded timestamps supplied by caller, unknown extensions, and conditional/idempotency headers are rejected. Native entered-in-error action is the reviewed error workflow. POST assigns ID/version; PUT requires matching id, If-Match and X-Change-Reason.

author_label.description: Current tenant staff directory label, not a historical identity snapshot; immutable actor_id remains authoritative.
